<description>
Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36388 (llvm-symbolizer broken pipe complaints) by replacing the unclean Bitcoin Core shutdown with a clean one in `init_fd_overflow_test`.
</description>

<commits>
fad49a733d test: Extract and use sigterm_node in init_fd_overflow_test

Changes:

* Extract a shared get_process_group_kwargs() to avoid repeating it
* In sigterm_node, use node.wait_until_stopped() instead of the manual
  assert_equal(0, node.process.wait())
* Extract sigterm_node; can be reviewed via the git options
  --color-moved=dimmed-zebra --color-moved-ws=ignore-all-space
* Use self.sigterm_node(node)+get_process_group_kwargs() over
  node.kill_process() for a graceful shutdown to avoid complaints from
  the llvm-symbolizer about a broken pipe when it resolves UBSAN
  suppressions during a process kill
</commits>
